name: The Killing Fields
summary: In Westfall, The Killing Fields begins with Farmer Saldean's crops under threat. Rogue Harvest Watchers overrun his fields and neighboring farms, while the Defias Brotherhood's disruption has left local agriculture in ruin.

sections.title: A Beleaguered Homestead
sections.body: Many Westfall farmers abandoned their land when bandits and outlaws swept through. Farmer Saldean and his family chose to stay. Thieves are not the only danger on their farm. Harvest Watchers built to tend and guard the grain have run wild, pacing the furrows and attacking anyone who comes near.

sections.title: Clearing the Soil
sections.body: Farmer Saldean asks passing travelers to dismantle twenty hostile Harvest Watchers across his fields and the adjoining plots. Clearing them gives his harvest a little relief. For now, his farm remains one stubborn hope that Westfall's breadbasket can be reclaimed.

faq.q: Who offers the quest The Killing Fields?
faq.answer: Farmer Saldean offers The Killing Fields from Saldean's Farm, along the road in central Westfall.

Harvest Watchers are clockwork scarecrows built to tend crops and guard fields from pests. After unrest and abandonment spread through Westfall, many were left untended or reprogrammed. Now they attack the farmers they were built to serve.

faq.q: Why has Farmer Saldean not fled Westfall like the others?
faq.answer: Farmer Saldean refuses to surrender his livelihood as his neighbors abandon their homesteads to thieves and brigands. He keeps his farm with help from hired adventurers who drive back the rogue machinery.

faq.q: What are the objectives of The Killing Fields?
aliases: what to kill for killing fields
faq.answer: You are asked to destroy twenty Harvest Watchers roaming Saldean's fields and the surrounding abandoned farms.
Saldean means the thieves and brigands loosely organized under the Defias Brotherhood. Their raids and extortion drove most homesteaders from their land.

faq.q: Does completing this quest fix Westfall's farming troubles?
faq.answer: Destroying twenty Harvest Watchers gives Saldean's farm some immediate breathing room. The bandit threat and broken machinery across the wider region remain.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help protect one of the few food supplies still standing in a territory the Stormwind crown has abandoned.
As an engineer, you can recognize the Harvest Watchers as clockwork wonders gone haywire without proper maintenance.
